stop.cmd: cd backend && .venv-wsl/bin/ruff check apps/ && .venv-wsl/bin/ruff format --check apps/ && cd .. && APPS=$( { git diff --name-only HEAD; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard; } | grep -E '^backend/apps/[^/]+/' | cut -d/ -f1-3 | sort -u | tr '\n' ' ' ) && if [ -n "$APPS" ]; then backend/.venv-wsl/bin/pytest -c backend/pyproject.toml -m 'not slow' -q -x -p no:cacheprovider $APPS; rc=$?; [ $rc -eq 0 ] || [ $rc -eq 5 ]; fi

commit.cmd: cd backend && .venv-wsl/bin/ruff check apps/ && .venv-wsl/bin/ruff format --check apps/ && cd .. && backend/.venv-wsl/bin/pytest -c backend/pyproject.toml -m 'not slow' -q -x -p no:cacheprovider
